Suitability policy: High requires feasible eligibility, positive modeled objective benefit, and observed annual-energy plus physical-input provenance. Medium means benefit is calculable from synthetic/estimated inputs or eligibility is conditional. Low means explicit incompatibility/already-present or no positive objective benefit. Ranking position alone never sets suitability.
